outline: 本課程旨在探討製造服務化相關議題如全球發展趨勢、製造服務化內涵、驅動力與轉換過程、產品服務系統、以及各國相關個案研討如歐盟製造服務化發展(Manufacture Platform)、芬蘭Tekes個案、美國產品服務化個案、IBM個案、及我國產業個案等研討。
schedule:
1.課程說明及評分
2.製造服務化發展
3.製造服務化方法論
4.Production Service System - Development and State of Art
5.Project Proposal
6.Production Service System - Strategy
7.Production Service System - Design
8.Production Service System - Supply Chain
9.Production Service System - Green Issue
10.Production Service system - Case Study
11.Service Science Management, and Engineering (SSME)- Developmeny and State of Art
12.Project Progress Report
13.SSME-Quality
14.SSME-Cost
15.SSME-Application I
16.SSME-Application II
17.Industrial Production Service System
18.Project Report
assessment:
課堂論文報告  50%
課堂論文平論  20%
project       20%
出席          10%
